blocked.camera: The camera or microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it with the icon in the address bar, then try again. If you never said no, your computer's privacy settings may be blocking the browser.
blocked.microphone: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it with the icon in the address bar, then try again. If you never said no, your computer's privacy settings may be blocking the browser.

notAllowed.camera: This page is not allowed to use the camera or microphone. Reload 3Speak and try again.
notAllowed.microphone: This page is not allowed to use the microphone. Reload 3Speak and try again.

busy.camera: Your camera or microphone is busy in another app or tab (a video call, another recorder). Close it there, then try again.
busy.microphone: Your microphone is busy in another app or tab (a video call, another recorder). Close it there, then try again.

notFound.camera: No camera or microphone found. Connect one, then try again.
notFound.microphone: No microphone found. Connect one, then try again.

noDevices.camera: This browser cannot use the camera or microphone here.
noDevices.microphone: This browser cannot use the microphone here.

failed.camera: The camera or microphone could not start. Try again.
failed.microphone: The microphone could not start. Try again.

failedNamed.camera: The camera or microphone could not start ({{name}}). Try again.
failedNamed.microphone: The microphone could not start ({{name}}). Try again.

inline.gestures: Hold and drag a picture to reframe it, pinch to zoom.
inline.gesturesOverlay: Hold and drag a picture to reframe it, pinch to zoom, drag your camera box to move it.

greenScreen.label: Green screen
greenScreen.staticTitle: Static background (experimental): removes whatever matches a shot of the empty background
greenScreen.thresholdStaticTitle: Tolerance: higher ignores more change in the background (noise, light, focus) but can start to remove parts of you
greenScreen.thresholdTitle: Higher removes more of the screen colour
greenScreen.despillStaticTitle: Removes the wall colour from the edges
greenScreen.despillGreenTitle: Removes the green tint from the edges
greenScreen.despillBlueTitle: Removes the blue tint from the edges
greenScreen.plateKeep: Experimental. Keep the camera and the light exactly as they are.
greenScreen.plateHowTo: Experimental. Fix the camera in place, press the button and step out of the picture.
greenScreen.keyFailed: Live keying is not available here. The clip still gets the green screen setting.
